---
name: provenance-check
description: Check Ventura OpenSource references copied material and adaptations for upstream attribution and license compliance. Use when external code documentation examples or assets influence a change. Do not use when the change is only an original annotation around a canonical link.
---

# Provenance check

- Identify the exact upstream project and version or source affected.
- Read its license and attribution requirements before copying or adapting material.
- Distinguish link reference inspiration copy and derivative work.
- Keep `PROVENANCE.md` aligned when present.
- Preserve required notices and avoid incompatible relicensing claims.
- Prefer linking when reuse rights are unclear.
